{{Quote|Welcome aboard the ''Spirit of Vengeance'', Champion.|Mandalore the Vindicated to the Grand Champion of the Great Hunt|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''''Spirit of Vengeance''''' was a large, [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] under the [[Commander/Legends|command]] of [[Mandalore the Vindicated]].

==History==
The massive [[Color/Legends|black]]-[[Hull/Legends|hulled]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] served as the Mandalorian [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|leader's]] mobile [[Command ship/Legends|command center]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], when [[Gender/Legends|he]] was away from his stronghold on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Many were said to find the dreadnaught's unique profile and numerous weapon emplacements intimidating. Within the ''Spirit of Vengeance'', was a large hall wherein a conference and dining table was kept, situated before the personal desk of Mandalore, himself. Among the ship's internal stockpile of consumables was a substantial quantity of the Mandalorian black [[Ale/Legends|ale]], [[Black ale/Legends|''ne'tra gal'']].<ref name="TOR" />

After claiming victory in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]]—a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunting competition—the most recent [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion]] was summoned to the ''Spirit of Vengeance'' by Mandalore the Vindicated. There, the accomplished [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] was introduced to the other living [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt|Grand Champions]], and was offered a place in Mandalore's clan.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Spirit of Vengeance'' first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', created by [[BioWare]] and released [[December 20]], [[2011]].
